title: Which line lets the search term into the query?
brief: Dan's found another search box that misbehaves. No patch this time — just point at the line where the customer's input stops being data and becomes part of the statement.

decoyLines.2: reading a value from the request is fine — it is what happens to it next that matters
decoyLines.3: sort is checked against a fixed list before use, so it can only ever be one of two safe strings
decoyLines.5: the query is already built by this point; the damage was done on the line above

attackSuite.label: The term ends the string early

hints: Two things from the request reach the query. Only one of them gets there unchanged.
Look for the line where a customer's text is spliced into a string that the database will run.
